resolved_source_locations.conclusion: We present a reproducible computational framework for defining and measuring agency in finite controlled Markov kernels without assuming goals, utilities, or homunculi. The framework operationalizes three complementary metrics: (i) viability kernels (greatest controlled-invariant safe sets under ledger-gated feasibility and successor-support semantics), (ii) feasible empowerment (channel capacity of the induced action-to-output channel restricted by budgets), and (iii) an empirical packaging endomap whose idempotence defect quantifies objecthood for coarse lenses. Building on Six Birds Theory (SBT, ), we propose that an agent is a theory object—a maintained package inside an induced layer with a ledger-gated interface—and we separate agenthood (enablement: the layer exists and persists) from agency (causation: interface interventions change outside futures). Throughout, ``theory'' is used in the SBT technical sense—a closure (lens + completion + audit)—not as a speculative hypothesis or manuscript-type category. Across matched-control ablations in a minimal ring-world substrate, we obtain four auditable separations: (1) calibrated null regimes prevent false positives (single-action: 0-bit empowerment; schedule trap: 1 bit under the wrong model, 0 under the correct one); (2) enabling repair collapses idempotence defect at =2 from 1 to 0; (3) enabling protocol holonomy leaves H=1 unchanged but increases empowerment for H 2 ; and (4) operator rewriting (skill ) monotonically increases median empowerment ( 0.73 1.34 bits). All experiments are driven by deterministic, hash-traceable scripts with a strict audit mode, and a Lean 4 anchor formalizes the viability-kernel fixed-point property. We are explicit that stronger claims about goals, consciousness, or real organisms are not established here; our conclusions rely on finite witnesses and operational proxies under explicit controls.

resolved_source_locations.conclusion: Randomness is often treated as either ontic indeterminacy or epistemic ignorance. We develop a third, operational account within Six Birds: layer-relative randomness is the predictive residue of non-closure under a chosen packaging and budget. For a micro process X_t and a packaging : X Y , we define the micro-closure deficit at scale by CD_ ( )=I(X_t; Y_ t+ Y_t) , the information about the next packaged state that remains hidden inside the current macro-object. This yields the exact decomposition H(Y_ t+ Y_t)=H(Y_ t+ X_t)+CD_ ( ) , separating intrinsic substrate uncertainty from randomness introduced by discarded distinctions. We connect this exact quantity to computable diagnostics native to earlier Six Birds work, including route mismatch for coarse-grained Markov dynamics and predictive log-loss gaps under limited-memory models. In controlled Markov benchmarks, closure deficit vanishes on exactly lumpable partitions and rises with within-fiber heterogeneity, while route mismatch tracks it closely. In budgeted prediction, increasing memory order buys back hidden distinctions and lowers held-out log loss. In toy hashing, one-wayness and random-lookingness emerge as the same packaging-and-budget phenomenon: high-entropy inputs obey q/2^n inversion scaling, while low-entropy inputs collapse the effect. The result is a measurable account of randomness that unifies coarse-graining, limited prediction, and feasible one-wayness without treating randomness as primitive.

resolved_source_locations.conclusion: The most direct next construction is a within-agent learning or acquisition carrier, in which the individual agent is treated as a carrier object in the sense of the Six Birds treatment of agency . The failed crystallization bridge in shows that experience-as-composition selection makes the finite carrier more homogeneous and more stage-predictable, whereas the data show history-dependence growing with experience. A carrier in which individual agents acquire conditional rules over their own histories would test the mechanism that this contrast leaves open. A second direction is a broader family of noisy and dissipative carriers, to map route memory beyond the tested noise grid and to learn when currentizable traces become genuinely coherent. A third is to enlarge the strategic and payoff substrate: richer automata, larger action spaces, asymmetric games, and longer public signals would test which carrier facts persist and which are artifacts of the minimal catalog. The run layer also invites a bounded-rationality connection. The imitation dynamics used here contain a logit-style temperature parameter; in a maximum-entropy or shadow-price reading, such a parameter can be interpreted as the dual of a binding cognitive or informational budget rather than a free behavioral knob . That connection is only an opening in this paper, but it suggests how run-only constants might be tied to explicit resource constraints. On the empirical side, the immediate extension is broader pre-registered testing of the residue hypothesis and the timing reversal on other repeated-game datasets, with the same discipline: hypotheses, predictors, bands, folds, and amendments fixed before outcome analysis.
